description: This PHP source file defines the ReportGeneratorDao class, which handles database interactions for report-related data in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to retrieve, save, and delete report entities, as well as manage report fields, groups, filters, and search functionalities related to report generation and processing.

classes.name: ReportGeneratorDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for reports in OrangeHRM, providing methods for retrieving, saving, updating, and deleting report entities and related fields, with transaction management and search capabilities.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves display fields selected for a specific report by report ID.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldGroupIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of display field groups associated with a specific report.

methods.name: getSelectedCompositeDisplayFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves composite display fields associated with a specific report.

methods.name: getSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves filter fields selected for a report.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches a report entity by report ID.

methods.name: getSummaryDisplayFieldByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves summary display fields for a report.

methods.name: saveReport
methods.description: Transactional method to save report data, including display fields, groups, and filters.

methods.name: saveSelectedFilterField
methods.description: Persists an array of selected filter fields.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayField
methods.description: Persists selected display fields for a report.

methods.name: saveSelectedDisplayFieldGroup
methods.description: Persists selected display field groups for a report.

methods.name: getFilterFieldByName
methods.description: Retrieves a filter field entity by its name.

methods.name: searchPimDefinedReports
methods.description: Searches for PIM-defined reports based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportsPaginator
methods.description: Builds paginator for searching PIM-defined reports.

methods.name: getSearchPimDefinedReportCount
methods.description: Returns the count of PIM-defined reports matching search parameters.

methods.name: deletePimDefinedReport
methods.description: Deletes PIM-defined reports by their IDs.

methods.name: getReportById
methods.description: Fetches a report by ID, returning null if not found.

methods.name: getExistingReportIdsForPim
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of existing reports related to PIM.

methods.name: getReportGroupByName
methods.description: Retrieves a report group entity by name.

methods.name: deleteExistingReportRecordsByReportId
methods.description: Deletes all related report records for a given report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Deletes selected display field groups for a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedDisplayFields
methods.description: Deletes selected display fields for a report.

methods.name: deleteSelectedFilterFields
methods.description: Deletes selected filter fields for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of display fields selected for a report.

methods.name: getSelectedDisplayFieldIdsByReportGroupId
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of display fields by report and group IDs.

methods.name: getIncludeType
methods.description: Retrieves the include-type filter field associated with a report.

methods.name: isIncludeHeader
methods.description: Checks if a display field group is marked as header for a report.

methods.name: getDisplayFieldGroupIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of display field group IDs associated with a report.

methods.name: getSkippedSelectedFilterFieldsByReportId
methods.description: Retrieves filter fields that are skipped for a report.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFieldGroups
methods.description: Retrieves all display field groups.

methods.name: getAllDisplayFields
methods.description: Retrieves all display fields with non-null display field groups.

methods.name: getAllFilterFields
methods.description: Retrieves all filter fields belonging to the 'pim' report group excluding the 'include' filter.
